claims.quote: Brochis amandajanea, long known as Corydoras amandajanea, is an armoured catfish from the Rio Miuã system of streams off the upper Rio Negro in Brazil.
Type locality is 'Rio Miuã system of streams, possibly the Uarinabe stream, 10-12 km from its confluence of the Upper Negro R., Brazil'.
